mapper.sql: FROM tb_ai_log_module_config config INNER JOIN tb_ai_log_issue_group g ON g.environment = config.environment AND g.system_code = config.system_code AND g.module_code = config.module_code AND config.enabled = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.review_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.review_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND v.process_status = 'PENDING' AND v.owner_user_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_assign, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.process_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.process_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.process_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.process_status = 'IGNORED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ignored
SELECT id, severity, ai_category, result_title, result_summary, blame_author_name FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND id IN #{id}

SELECT id, sample_event_id, judgement, severity, ai_category, result_title, result_summary, root_cause, analysis_basis, impact_description, recommendation, suggested_resolution_days, confidence, verification, uncertainty, blame_author_name, finish_time FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND id IN #{id}

SELECT issue_group_id, COALESCE(SUM(occurrence_count), 0) AS occurrence_count, MIN(first_seen_time) AS first_occurred_at, MAX(last_seen_time) AS last_occurred_at,
SUM(CASE WHEN log_date = #{logDate} THEN occurrence_count ELSE 0 END)
NULL AS date_occurrence_count FROM tb_ai_log_error_event WHERE issue_group_id IN #{id} GROUP BY issue_group_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_ai_log_error_event WHERE issue_group_id = #{issueGroupId}

SELECT id, issue_group_id, analysis_task_id, file_record_id, log_date, occurrence_count, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, sample_content, sample_content_truncated, exception_class, exception_message, root_cause_exception, root_cause_message, normalized_message, simplified_stack, trace_id, tid, request_id, reason_code, root_cause_category, matched_rule_id, expected, ai_required FROM tb_ai_log_error_event WHERE issue_group_id = #{issueGroupId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT environment, system_code, module_code FROM tb_ai_log_module_config WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY environment, system_code, module_code
